briefs.findings: Approved purpose: one reader saves articles and marks them read without losing title or address. Accounts, sharing and recommendations are excluded. Design fixes local Node, JSON persistence and queue ownership. Glossary includes read articles in the queue. No contradictory goals or unresolved decisions.
limitations: No README, standards, prior audit or instruction files exist. Main-thread research is proportionate to three short files.

briefs.findings: Documented queue operations: save, list, mark-read. Presentation must use them and cannot write storage directly. Observed tracked inventory contains only three documents; there is no implementation to assess for violations.
limitations: No import graph or executable product. Measurement describes documents only; no two declared plans exist for overlap analysis.

briefs.findings: No manifest, lockfile, prepared environment, formatter, linter, type configuration, test suite or CI exists. Inspect and inventory passed; host Git 2.54.0 and Node v24.17.0 are available. The approved journey has no executable protection.
limitations: Application checks cannot run until implementation and commands exist; installed audit helpers do not establish application readiness.

briefs.findings: Node is approved. Official Node documentation describes the stable built-in node:test runner and node --test invocation. It is a small candidate for real-file public-interface checks without adding a test framework.
limitations: No project runtime pin or check command exists; only stable runner basics were researched.

briefs.findings: No third-party service or external integration is required by the approved local application.
limitations: No live service probes are relevant to this audit.
